small_guidance:
- Add autotune configs with larger BLOCK_N (e.g. 256/512) paired with BLOCK_OC=32 and num_warps=8, since OC=64 means BLOCK_OC=64 already covers full OC in one program — reducing pid_oc to 1 and tiling N more aggressively may improve occupancy.
- BLOCK_K is power-of-2 padded from K_REAL=72 to 128, wasting ~44% of the dot. Try splitting K into two stages (e.g. iterate ic with BLOCK_K=KH*KW=16 inner, accumulate over IC=8) so the GEMM-K loop matches K_REAL exactly and avoids masked-zero lanes.
- Try swapping pid_n / pid_oc order (or use a swizzle / grouped-M ordering) for better L2 reuse of weights when BLOCK_OC tiles iterate slower.
large_guidance:
- Switch to a channels-last (NHWC) input/output layout: permute x to (B,IH,IW,IC) once on host (or fold into the kernel) so the GEMM-K dim (IC*KH*KW with IC contiguous) yields fully coalesced, contiguous loads of IC=8 lanes per (kh,kw); current NCHW layout makes the K reduction non-contiguous.
- Restructure as an explicit im2col GEMM where the inner loop iterates over (kh, kw) with BLOCK_K=IC=8 (or 16 padded) per step, so each iteration loads a contiguous IC vector — eliminates the BLOCK_K=128 padding waste on K_REAL=72.
- Consider one-program-per-(N-tile) with full OC handled inside (since OC=64 fits in a single 64-wide tile), making the kernel a pure persistent loop over output spatial tiles; fuse bias+hardswish+relu in epilogue (already done) and write NHWC output then permute back, or write NCHW directly via strided store.
